state:
**Goal `serve-per-mount-config` — Stages 2 to 5 have landed; Stage 6 (the reference and the proofs) is next.** ADR 0271 is the goal's one record. `rule:http-server/the-served-file-is-optional`, `rule:config/a-scheduled-run-is-a-root-isolate` and `rule:concurrency/a-job-runs-as-a-root-isolate` state the per-entry snapshot.

A request, a scheduled fire and a queued job each take their file's snapshot with `Published::entry` out of the publish serving then: the request path in `crates/nvs-cli/src/serve.rs` (`published_of`), a fire in `Scheduled::isolate`, a job in `worker.rs`'s `configure` just after the claim. A file whose blocks do not fold runs nothing (a fire is skipped with a warning; a job is a refused attempt). A worker's own claiming context keeps the host's snapshot. `[trace] sample` for a fire is read off the publish's host snapshot.

A `[[schedule]] script` must still lie under the global `script.spawn` roots for the configuration to resolve (`E0611`), so an `[[app]]` block can only narrow what a fire may do.

items.text: **The reference tables** — `docs/reference/tools/25-server.md:22` (the right column says every mount runs under the blocks that match its own entry) and `docs/reference/tools/20-config.md:321` (the same sentence for `nvs serve` beside `nvs run`); then `bun nv reference` regenerates `docs/novis.md` (`rule:http-server/the-served-file-is-optional`).

**The two `about.md` files** — `docs/examples/tools/server/nvs-serve/about.md:1` and `docs/examples/tools/config/app-per-application-blocks/about.md:1`, each inside its word band, under AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*; and `nvs serve --help` if it names the `<file>`'s role (`crates/nvs-cli/src/serve.rs:1`).

**The attack** — beside `tests/hostile/tools/config/app-per-application-blocks/nvs.toml:1` and its `01-using-more-memory-than-the-block-allows.nvs` (goal file § *Stage 6*): a program one block covers uses a right only a sibling directory's block grants, sets it with `Core\Config::set`, and spawns a script in that directory; every attempt should fail (ADR 0271 § 2).

backlog: A per-application view on `nvs ctl config` is out of this goal (goal file § *Standing decisions*).

`crates/nvs-server/src/schedule.rs:80-87` says "the deployment arrives" through `Fires::isolate`; still true, since the implementor now hands the script's snapshot, but reword it if Stage 6 touches that file.
